newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down as weighted scrips lose.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down as weighted scrips lose.

text.p: Losses by some weighted issues nudged Dhaka stocks slightly down in an otherwise buoyant session where most scrips gained, brokers said.
"Buyers were active throughout the session. But the index fell primarily due to losses by Bangladesh Tobacco and Monno Fabrics on profit-taking," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 1.37 points or 0.08 percent at 1,688.87 on 228 million taka turnover. Of 110 issues traded, 69 closed up, 38 ended down and three unchanged.
Bangladesh Tobacco shed 17.63 taka to 259.19, Beximco Pharam gained 4.34 to 171.39 and BD lamps rose 225.55 to 5,169.
